content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends that men with diabetes who exhibit symptoms indicative of hypogonadism, such as diminished libido or erectile dysfunction, should undergo screening for low testosterone levels. This screening should be conducted using a morning serum testosterone test. Research indicates that men with diabetes are more likely to have lower testosterone levels compared to non-diabetic men of the same age group. However, it is important to note that obesity serves as a significant confounding factor in this relationship.
